DESCRIPTION:
The figure presents a clustered bar chart illustrating the daily increase in new patients and the daily confirmed COVID-19 cases over time. The horizontal axis represents dates, ranging from July 15, 2022, to August 26, 2022, with a linear scale and evenly spaced date labels. The vertical axis represents the number of cases, labeled as "每日新增患者人数" and "每日媒体报道数量," with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1800000. The scale increments are 200000. Two data series are displayed: "该国全球确诊数量" (total confirmed cases in the country) and "有关covid-19新闻媒体报道数量" (number of COVID-19 news media reports). The "该国全球确诊数量" series is represented by teal-colored bars, while the "有关covid-19新闻媒体报道数量" series is represented by light green-colored bars. The bars are grouped by date, with the teal and light green bars positioned side-by-side for each date. The teal bars vary in height, with the tallest bar reaching approximately 1600000 on August 12, 2022, and the shortest bar reaching approximately 80000 on July 15, 2022. The light green bars also vary in height, with the tallest bar reaching approximately 6000 on August 12, 2022, and the shortest bar reaching approximately 1000 on July 15, 2022. The bars are not sorted in any particular order, and no bars are visually emphasized.
